remarks: Great Opportunity ! Vinyl sided 3 bedroom, 2 bath single family home in Orchard Park. Front living room/dining room with hardwood flooring, TV, and bay window. Updated kitchen with cherry finished cabinets, Corian- edged countertops, recessed lighting, and stainless appliances. First floor bedroom and full bathroom. Second floor main bedroom with vaulted ceiling and adjoining bathroom with Jacuzzi tub. Additional bedroom and loft den/sitting area. Sliding door off kitchen to a large sunroom that overlooks the backyard. Updates include most windows, house roof ( tear-off, 2023), furnace, hot water tank, sump pump with water back up, garage roof, and back steps to the sunroom. Detached garage with storage area. Large driveway allows for extra parking. West Seneca Schools. Convenient location.
